name: Battle ropes
pattern: Athletic half squat while the arms whip two heavy rope ends into waves, slams or circles.
setup: Rope anchored at the middle; hold one end in each hand, thumbs up.
Step back until the rope has a little slack.
Feet shoulder width, hips back, knees bent, chest up.

steps.text: Snap the right hand up to chest height as the left drives down.
Switch fast: left up, right down. Keep the waves reaching the anchor.

cues.cue: Stay in a quarter to half squat, hips back.
cues.why: The legs and trunk brace the body so the arms can drive; rope work loads the trunk muscles as well as the arms.

cues.cue: Chest up, ribs down, back flat.
cues.why: A rounded back under fast arm work strains the spine.

cues.cue: Move from the shoulders, elbows soft, hands to chest height.
cues.why: Shoulder-driven waves keep the rope moving to the anchor.

cues.cue: Short hard bouts: 15-30 s on, rest as long.
cues.why: Rope work drives oxygen uptake and heart rate very high, higher than many body-weight and lifting exercises.

breathing: Short sharp breaths out with the waves; do not hold your breath.

tempo.note: About 2 waves a second per arm in alternating waves.

mistakes.name: Standing up tall
mistakes.looks: Knees straight, hips forward, only the arms move.
mistakes.fix: Sit back into a half squat.
mistakes.why: Loses the brace and the legs' help; the back takes the shock.

mistakes.name: Back rounds
mistakes.looks: Shoulders hunch forward over the rope.

mistakes.name: Waves die before the anchor
mistakes.looks: Rope flaps near the hands only.
mistakes.fix: Bigger, faster arm drives, or step closer.

safety: Shoulder pain: use lower, smaller waves and fewer slams.

variants.change: Rope training sits in vigorous calisthenics: about 7.5 MET (02020).
Kneeling or seated: arm and trunk work only, lower energy cost.
Combined with leg moves: higher energy cost; leg keyframes from that family.

subtypes.name: Alternating waves
subtypes.change: Default keyframes. Kneeling and seated: legs still, trunk upright.

subtypes.name: Double waves and slams
subtypes.change: Both arms together; slams lift the rope overhead and drive it down with a hip hinge.

subtypes.name: Circles and side to side
subtypes.change: Arms sweep outward or across; Russian twist turns the trunk side to side while seated.

motion.basis: Energy cost from fountaine2015 and ratamess2015; muscle activity from calatayud2015. Angles are estimates of a coaching-standard half squat.

sources.cite: Fountaine CJ, Schmidt BJ. Metabolic cost of rope training. J Strength Cond Res. 2015;29(4):889-893.
